scope: Static research only; production, reference applications, firmware and decompiler caches unchanged.

verification.limit: Integrity and byte equality only; not complete semantic or interoperability verification.

claims.claim: Same transport-server Mach service, server/client NSXPC protocols and exported ACCTransportServerRemote object identified; protocol argument preserved on successful endpoint creation path.
claims.limits: Conditional on XPC acceptance/connection ownership and successful object creation; no Apple runtime/XPC wire execution.

claims.claim: Connection publication invokes endpoint publication; protocol0 bypasses known-protocol publish dispatch, then posts analytics/connection-info notifications.
claims.limits: Notification receivers and policy/restricted-mode effects not exhaustively audited; not proof that all upper-level timers are absent.

claims.claim: BT endpoint-properties handler reads Bluetooth_HIDFunction and calls HidService vtable+0xf0 -> 0x1006bc160; authenticated guard plus previous/current-property presence gates verified.
claims.limits: UUID x4 is connectionUUID, not endpointUUID. Downstream conditional virtual notification at 0x1006ad6fc remains unresolved; no global no-timer conclusion.

claims.claim: Parallel connection-auth-status callback also gets endpoint HIDFunction property and calls same HidService virtual target, carrying auth status.
claims.limits: Authentication producer/lifecycle and all side effects not closed.

claims.claim: 0x1000d4ee0 folds 0x54->1, 0x55->2, other->0x80000000 with OR; duplicates alone do not invalidate a complete 54/55 pair.
claims.limits: Feature validator only. Entire SYN still subject to independent count/length/session checks. Existing production size==2 condition is stricter; not changed in this audit.

example_basis: Manual derivation from original assembly; not firmware execution or a new production test.
